html:
Car Parking Multiplayer 2 is the ultimate car sandbox and auto-life simulator, bringing together a massive car meet culture and legal motorsport. Explore a massive open world, customize cars beyond recognition, and compete with thousands of real players thanks to full crossplay support.

Key features of the game:

Full crossplay and a living world

Burst into a unified ecosystem! The PC version offers full cross-platform play with mobile devices. The game servers are always full: communicate via built-in voice chat, organize car meets, pull into gas stations and auto shops, add like-minded people to your friends list, and trade cars right on the city streets.

Car hangouts and customization

Make your car unique:

  • Interior and detailing: Every car has a fully detailed cabin and interior. Some models have multiple interior options available, and sports cars will surprise you with animated retractable panels.

  • Deep tuning: Adjust suspension and wheel camber. Perform full engine, turbocharger, gearbox, and exhaust system swaps.

  • Visual style: Create a unique look with dynamic vinyls and a variety of body parts.

Variety of game formats

The game offers content for both single-player enthusiasts and multiplayer fans:

  • Racing mode: Try your hand at four official disciplines — Drag, Circuit racing, Drift, and Rally.

  • Free activities: Head to the Drift and Time Attack tracks, available both in single-player for practice and in multiplayer to compete with friends.

  • Parking and driving challenges: Test your driving skills in 82 real-world parking and driving challenges. Challenges await you across a wide variety of vehicle classes — from classic and sports cars to pickups, tow trucks, and heavy trucks.

  • Auto-life simulator: Try on basic roles in the open world — work as a taxi driver or patrol the streets in police mode, issuing fines to other players.

Built for PC

Explore the world comfortably with full support for PC peripherals: keyboard and mouse controls, gamepads, as well as racing wheels with Force Feedback for maximum car control. The game is adapted for a wide variety of display resolutions, including modern ultra-wide monitors.
